semiconductor_relevance: High — YUJAY Technology Inc. specializes in vacuum and coating technologies for semiconductor applications, providing essential equipment for wafer processing and packaging.
summary: YUJAY Technology Inc. develops advanced vacuum and coating equipment for the semiconductor industry, including systems for evaporation, sputtering, CVD, and ALD. The company also offers surface treatment and inspection technologies to enhance yield and efficiency in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Coating equipment for evaporation, sputtering, CVD, and ALD
